title: Work from Anywhere, Spend Somewhere
subtitle: Remote Work and Local Labor Markets — An Ecrivain Sample Dissertation
author: Mateo J. Alvarado
premise: When remote-capable workers move into a local labor market, what happens to local service employment, wages and rents, and who gains?
audience: Illustrative sample: doctoral students writing an empirical economics dissertation with models, equations and event studies.
